The Sky She Left Me

Neha Kharel’s debut novel, free to read in full.

230 pages, in EnglishPublished October 2025

Two friends, one rooftop

Ishan and Anya grew up watching the sky from her rooftop.

Their friendship became something neither of them could name. Then one Sunday a message arrives, and Anya is gone. Ishan is left with her red diary, their unanswered questions and the dreams they never finished.

The Sky She Left Me follows the quiet weight of grief, and the fragile possibility of finding purpose in what remains.

Begin with Chapter 1

The novel deals with bereavement and suicide.

A line to keep

“You exist in my every tomorrow.”

From the Epilogue, page 226

From Neha

Neha Kharel wrote The Sky She Left Me as her first novel and designed its cover. It was published in October 2025 and printed by Buddha Offset Press in Birtamod, Jhapa.

Dear Reader, thank you for picking up this book. It truly means the world to me. This is my first ever book, and it carries a piece of my heart on every page.

Writing it has been a journey of emotions, reflection, and endless learning, and I’m beyond grateful that you chose to be a part of it.

Your support, feedback, and love inspire me to keep writing and growing. Thank you for being here at the beginning of this journey.

Neha Kharel

Author of The Sky She Left Me
